rows.role: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Home Surfaces
rows.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.
The Surfaces Podcasts team owns podcast recommendations across some of Spotify’s most visible surfaces, including Home and the Now Playing view. We build and improve the recommendation systems that help listeners discover their next favorite show or episode while helping creators reach the right audiences.
As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you’ll help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You’ll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences for listeners at global scale. You’ll take models from research to production, help set technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solve complex personalization challenges across Spotify.

What You'll Do:
Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience. Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally. Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences. Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches. Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Designers to define and execute experimentation strategies. Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale. Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of our personalization systems. Mentor and support other Machine Learning Engineers, sharing knowledge and helping strengthen engineering practices across the team.

Who You Are:
You have deep experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments. You have deep experience with recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms. You are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch. You have experience with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques, including SFT, distillation, and LoRA. You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization. You care about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful applications of machine learning. You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical partners and can influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team. You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes. You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks. You have experience building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

Where You'll Be:
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

The United States base range for this position is $227,495- $324,993 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Our mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. Everything we do is driven by our love for music and podcasting. Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

rows.description:
Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


We're looking for a Client Partner to join our Emerging & Scaled Sales team, one of the fastest-growing teams within Spotify Advertising. In this role, you'll own and grow a portfolio of strategic clients, serving as a trusted advisor who understands their business goals and delivers advertising solutions that drive measurable impact. You'll combine strategic thinking, commercial expertise, and relationship management to develop long-term partnerships while helping advertisers unlock the full value of Spotify's advertising platform.
 
If you're passionate about digital advertising, thrive in a consultative sales environment, and enjoy building lasting client relationships, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do:
Build and grow strategic relationships with advertisers by understanding their business objectives and delivering consultative, insight-driven recommendations. Own a portfolio of clients and develop account strategies that drive long-term growth, retention, and revenue expansion. Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities while expanding existing partnerships across your assigned market and vertical. Create compelling sales narratives by leveraging market insights, campaign learnings, audience intelligence, and Spotify's advertising solutions. Meet and exceed advertising revenue goals by developing strategic account plans and proactively identifying opportunities to grow your business. Analyze campaign performance and client data to develop actionable insights and optimization recommendations that improve business outcomes. Develop deep expertise in Spotify's advertising products, platform capabilities, and industry trends to position innovative solutions that align with client objectives. Manage an active sales pipeline, maintain accurate forecasting, and effectively prioritize opportunities across multiple accounts. rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.Join Anthropic's Customer Success team in a high-visibility & high-impact role driving AI adoption across a small number of strategic accounts in our Enterprise Tech segment. As our dedicated Outcomes AI Manager for Strategic Tech Customers you’ll be their partner and trusted advisor helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude Code, Cowork, and other surface areas. You'll work with a book of global technology leaders to actively deploy AI and reshape the technology landscape. You’ll be working with key partners who are moving fast and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with LLM technology. Your role will entail developing genuine partnerships with the customer and key stakeholders, gaining a deep understanding of their multi-pronged business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us. In partnership with the broader account team, you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage grows and evolves. Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, drive model and use case optimizations, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business. Responsibilities: Build trusting, strategic relationships with key customer decision makers in complex, matrixed organizations; understand their business and objectives and identify opportunities for optimization and expansion Own customer operations across the lifecycle of each account, maintaining a structured operational assessment (customer readiness, operational health, strategic alignment, enablement strategy, adoption intelligence) that grounds comprehensive account and success plans and Executive Business Reviews Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude Code and Cowork, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions Leverage your deep knowledge of each customer, and the patterns you see across your other Tech accounts, to proactively drive consumption planning and the value story behind it, developing credible ROI hypotheses and quantifying outcomes that build the case for continued and expanded investment. Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities across Claude surface areas (API, Claude Code, Cowork) to drive full value from contracted commitments Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement Ruthlessly prioritize across the account's many business units and workstreams, building programmatic, repeatable motions You may be a good fit if you have: 6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, or Strategy Consulting Experience working with F500 technology companies, SaaS platforms, or digital-first businesses at the exec level—ideally including high-growth and established tech companies. You understand what it means to lead organization-wide change or adoption programs (multiple functions, hundreds of users) for a product that requires C-suite sponsorship Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns across a set of diverse stakeholders—from developers and product managers to executives and end users Proven track record managing a portfolio of accounts while maintaining strong relationships and driving measurable outcomes — you can run multiple enterprise motions in parallel without letting any account go quiet. Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems. You have built with Claude Code, automating your own workflows with agents, skills, and tooling. A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic "roll up your sleeves" mentality The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$265,000—$320,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.description:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

What You Will Do:
Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing. Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout. Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention. Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments. Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact. Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities. Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth. Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.

Where You'll Be:
You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems. You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay. You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth. You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions. You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities. You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities. You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence decisions, and align cross-functional teams around shared goals. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing assumptions, learning from outcomes, and adapting your approach as new insights emerge.

Where You Will Be:
This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.

This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.

lists.content:
• Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing.
  • Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout.
  • Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention.
  • Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments.
  • Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact.
  • Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities.
  • Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth.
  • Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.

• You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems.
  • You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay.
  • You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth.
  • You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions.
  • You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities.
  • You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities.
  • You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence decisions, and align cross-functional teams around shared goals.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing assumptions, learning from outcomes, and adapting your approach as new insights emerge.

• This role is based in London, United Kingdom or Stockholm, Sweden.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.Applications are now open for our January cohort - apply here by October 30. Anthropic Fellows Program overview The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience. Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis. What to expect 4 months of full-time research Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK) Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country) Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses Interview process The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Compensation The expected base stipend for this role is 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD per week, with an expectation of 40 hours per week for 4 months (with possible extension). Across the workstreams, you may be a good fit if you: Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole Are excited to transition into empirical AI research and would be interested in a full-time role at Anthropic Have a strong technical background in computer science, mathematics, or physics Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly Strong candidates may also have: Strong background in a discipline relevant to a specific Fellows workstream (e.g. economics, social sciences, or cybersecurity) Experience in areas of research or engineering related to their workstream Candidates must be: Fluent in Python programming Available to work full-time on the Fellows program AI Safety Fellows Mentors, research areas, & past projects Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include: Sam Bowman Sara Price Alex Tamkin Nina Panickssery Trenton Bricken Logan Graham Jascha Sohl-Dickstein Joe Benton Collin Burns Fabien Roger Samuel Marks Kyle Fish Ethan Perez Our mentors will lead projects in select AI safety research areas, such as: Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains. Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios. Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise. Model Internals / Mechanistic Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures. AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations. On our Alignment Science and Frontier Red Team blogs, you can read about past projects, including: Subliminal Learning: Language Models Transmit Behavioral Traits via Hidden Signals in Data: Alex Cloud and Minh Le, et al., mentors including Samuel Marks and Owain Evans Open-source circuits: Michael Hanna and Mateusz Piotrowski with mentorship from Emmanuel Ameisen and Jack Lindsey For a full list of representative projects for each area, please see these blog posts: Introducing the Anthropic Fellows Program for AI Safety Research, Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions. Unique candidate criteria You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you: Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems Have experience with empirical ML research projects Have experience working with large language models Have experience in one of the research areas mentioned above Have a track record of open-source contributions AI Security Fellows Mentors, research areas, & past projects Fellows will undergo a project selection & mentor matching process. Potential mentors include: Nicholas Carlini Keri Warr Evyatar Ben Asher Keane Lucas Newton Cheng On our Alignment Science and Frontier Red Team blogs, you can read about some past Fellows projects, including: AI agents find $4.6M in blockchain smart contract exploits: Winnie Xiao and Cole Killian, mentored by Nicholas Carlini and Alwin Peng Strengthening Red Teams: A Modular Scaffold for Control Evaluations: Chloe Loughridge et al., mentored by Jon Kutasov and Joe Benton Unique candidate criteria You might be a particularly great fit for this workstream if you: Are motivated by reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI systems Have contributed to open-source projects in LLM- or security-adjacent repositories Have demonstrated success in bringing clarity and ownership to ambiguous technical problems Have experience with pentesting, vulnerability research, or other offensive security work Have a demonstrated willingness to do the "dirty work" that produces high-quality outputs Have reported CVEs or been awarded bug bounties Have experience with empirical ML research projects Have experience with deep learning frameworks and experiment management Logistics Logistics Requirements: To participate in the Fellows program, you must have work authorization in the US, UK, or Canada and be located in that country during the program. Workspace Locations: We have designated shared workspaces in London and Berkeley where fellows will work from and mentors will visit. We are also open to remote fellows in the UK, US, or Canada. We will ask you about your availability to work from Berkeley or London (full- or part-time) during the program. Visa Sponsorship: We are not currently able to sponsor visas for fellows. To participate in the Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the UK, the US, or Canada. Program Duration: The program runs for 4 months, full-time. If you can't commit to the full duration, please still apply and note your constraints in the application. We review these requests on a case-by-case basis. rows.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

What You'll Do:
Own the product strategy and roadmap for your scope within Spotify Connect, turning the broader Seamless direction into clear priorities. Work with research and data colleagues to understand cross-device behavior, identify friction, and define measures of success. Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive and reliable experiences for discovering devices, controlling playback, and moving between them. Balance improvements to everyday usability and reliability with experiments that uncover new value. Work across teams and partner-facing functions to manage dependencies and deliver a coherent end-to-end experience. Explore opportunities created by richer device understanding and emerging ways of interacting with Spotify, keeping privacy, permissions, and user control central. Clearly communicate product choices, progress, and results, and use what you learn to improve the roadmap.

Who You Are:
You have experience owning and delivering high-quality consumer products, from identifying a problem through launch and iteration. You can translate user needs into clear priorities and sustain progress across multiple dependencies. You are comfortable working with technically complex products and can connect system behavior to the user experience. You can communicate and debate strategic and technical complexity with senior stakeholders. You use quantitative and qualitative evidence to make decisions and have experience designing and learning from experiments. You care about the details that make a product dependable and easy to use. You communicate clearly, collaborate well across disciplines, and are willing to work hands-on. You have experience with connected devices, playback, platform products, or cross-device experiences, or an interest in developing your expertise in these areas.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Stockholm or London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

  • You can communicate and debate strategic and technical complexity with senior stakeholders.

  • You care about the details that make a product dependable and easy to use.
  • You communicate clearly, collaborate well across disciplines, and are willing to work hands-on.

• This role is based in Stockholm or London.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays.

You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust.

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.About the Role We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer to lead technical direction across GitLab's Core DevOps services, the systems the majority of our users touch every day. Distinguished Engineers are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the most senior level of technical leadership within and across divisions at the company. Core DevOps builds continuous Integration, continuous deployment, planning, and source control experiences. These are among the most mature, highest traffic, and most deeply interconnected systems at GitLab. They carry years of accumulated architectural decisions, they sit in the critical path of our customers' own delivery pipelines, and they are being reshaped by the shift toward AI native development. The job is to raise their quality, converge them onto a coherent go-forward architecture, and retire accumulated risk, all without interrupting the millions of users and Fortune 100 organizations who depend on them. GitLab is pursuing a set of company-wide engineering goals: large gains in developer productivity, measurably higher quality in what we ship, and engineering practices reshaped around AI and agentic workflows. Core DevOps is where much of that strategy has to land, because these are the services our own engineers and our customers depend on daily. In this role you will bring that strategy into Core DevOps in a form that works for long lived production systems, and carry what you learn here back out to the rest of engineering. What You'll Do Set and continuously refine the go forward technical direction for CI, CD, Plan, and source code experiences, aligned against the horizontal architectural initiatives. Work directly with the VP of Engineering as her technical counterpart on planning, technical investment, and where the group's engineering effort should go. Translate GitLab's company-wide productivity, quality, and AI native engineering goals into concrete technical direction for Core DevOps, and turn into iterable roadmaps, partnering broadly across the org. Define what good means in measurable terms for these services, including availability, latency at p95 and p99, pipeline success rate, test reliability, data correctness, and defect escape rate, then hold designs and implementations to it. Maintain a clear and current picture of systemic technical risk across the group, including single points of failure, unowned critical paths, brittle coupling between CI/CD and Plan, scaling limits, and past decisions that now constrain the roadmap. Drive a prioritized plan to retire it. Lead the hardest design decisions hands on, writing code, prototypes, and proofs of concept where a design argument needs evidence behind it. Drive convergence on shared patterns, libraries, and paved paths, reducing how many different ways the same problem gets solved across the group. Design migration paths that let large, long lived systems change underneath users without breaking them, using incremental cutover, dual run, measurable rollback, and deprecation with clear timelines. Adopt the platform capabilities coming from GitLab's AI organization and the company's productivity initiatives into Core DevOps, feed this group's requirements back into them, and help prove what works on systems of this scale and maturity. Serve as the escalation point for complex or contested technical decisions across the group, including those where no single team owns the outcome. Review significant designs and merge requests in the group's critical paths, and use review to teach rather than only to gate. Ensure designs hold across GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, and respect multi-tenant, compliance, and data governance boundaries in each. Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and SRE so Core DevOps services are observable and debuggable, and so failure modes degrade gracefully instead of cascading. Make architectural constraints and opportunities clear to Product in roadmap terms, so that technical investment and product ambition get planned together instead of traded off late. Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let teams across the group make aligned decisions independently. Grow Principal and Staff Engineers across Core DevOps, raise the bar on design rigor and technical writing, and contribute to the technical hiring bar for senior individual contributors. Participate in the Incident Management on-call rotation to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com, and complete Interview Training to participate in hiring as a technical interviewer or panel member. What You'll Bring 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior technical leadership role. Deep expertise in AI and ML systems, including large language models, agentic frameworks, and autonomous workflow design at production scale. Proven track record of leading hands-on technical experimentation, including defining evaluation frameworks, running benchmarks, and translating findings into scalable architecture decisions. Strong background in scalable, multi-tenant distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience. Experience designing and implementing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for production systems. Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction across multiple teams or divisions without direct authority. Ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization with excellent written and asynchronous communication skills. rows.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Editor for Indonesia, to join Spotify’s Music Editorial team based in Jakarta. In this role you will be part of the Music team in Southeast Asia, reporting to the regional Head of Editorial.
You will contribute your expertise to various music-related projects within the company, including playlist curation, creative editorial work, and cross-functional collaboration with different teams in the region and beyond. You will provide deep cultural and musical insights to create highly engaging and cohesive music experiences for listeners, extending beyond playlists, while ensuring an unbiased editorial voice for a wide array of moods, moments, and genres. Additionally, you will drive artist discovery through an extensive editorial ecosystem of playlists and tools, critically assessing music trends and user behavior to identify opportunities and emerging trends.
You will demonstrate a team player spirit, a passion for performance-oriented analytics, and a solid understanding of Spotify’s role in the music industry both locally and globally. Additionally, you will have an editorial personality that thrives in engaging audiences through creative formats, bringing the playlists to life in innovative ways.
You will be encouraged to make data-informed decisions while also contributing creative and cultural expertise. Above all, your work will impact the way the world experiences music and strengthen Spotify’s role as a trusted, culturally relevant voice in the music landscape!

What You'll Do:
Develop and execute a holistic editorial strategy for Indonesia that aligns with regional business goals Shape and evolve our editorial voice across playlists, written and visual storytelling, and short-form content on and off platform Pioneer creative and innovative formats to bring playlists to life and deepen connection with listeners Proactively identify music trends, emerging talent, and opportunities in the local and global music landscape, acting as a cultural guide Curate cohesive, engaging playlists for Indonesia with compelling descriptions and commentary that resonate with audiences Lead editorial representation in high-impact cross-functional projects and strategic bets at both a regional and global level with teams like artist & label partnerships, marketing, design, PR, and product Maintain and refine a strong playlist ecosystem that supports artist discovery and deepens artist-fan engagement Analyze user behavior and performance data to optimize playlist engagement and make informed editorial decisions, translating high-level insights into actionable initiatives Collaborate with global and regional editorial teams on programming initiatives and strategies to enhance Spotify’s market position.

Who You Are:
At least 8+ years of experience in the music industry, journalism, programming/curating music for digital, radio, TV, or other media outlets You have deep knowledge of music and culture, possessing broad expertise across all genres and styles, from Indo Pop to HipDut, Indie to Javanese music, with the ability to curate music for diverse moods and moments Skilled at leveraging data and audience insights to support editorial decisions and build clear narratives You have a strong editorial voice and are culturally aware, with the ability to critically evaluate music trends, emerging movements, and audience behavior beyond just data A confident storyteller and public speaker, fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia to effectively advocate for the market and secure stakeholder buy-in An excellent communicator, capable of connecting with audiences through written, video, or audio commentary to enhance playlists You’re a team player who is detail-oriented and consistently demonstrates a positive attitude, adaptable and at ease navigating fast-changing priorities in a dynamic environment, comfortable navigating complex global-to-local organizational structures and aligning cross-functional teams around Editorial priorities  You are curious about how technology and culture intersect, constantly exploring new, innovative formats to keep Spotify at the forefront of the cultural zeitgeist You are comfortable on-camera and experienced crafting social-first content and working with video production teams You are knowledgeable of Google Suite tools, comfortable with basic design tools and workflows, capable of creating visual assets like playlist covers when necessary.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Jakarta We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

rows.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. Our team builds and operates the authorization and permissioning systems that enable creators and their teams to securely access and manage their presence across Spotify. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks. This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

What You'll Do::
Design, build, deploy, and operate scalable backend services that power authorization, permissions, and team management across Spotify. Take ownership of critical systems that enable creators, teams, agents, licensors, and other partners to securely access and manage the right content and capabilities. Evolve our backend architecture to support continued growth in users, use cases, and Spotify products while maintaining high standards for reliability, performance, and security. Improve the systems and workflows that enable creators to gain access to their content, profiles, and teams. Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs, balancing long-term architecture with solutions that meet current product and business needs. Partner with engineers and cross-functional collaborators across Spotify to understand authorization needs and build reusable platform capabilities. Contribute to frontend experiences and data-related work when useful, while bringing deep expertise and leadership to backend engineering. Raise engineering quality through strong technical judgment, design discussions, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing across the team.

Who You Are::
You have deep experience designing, building, and operating backend services, with strong knowledge of Java or comparable backend technologies. You have experience owning distributed, high-scale, or business-critical systems where reliability, performance, and security matter. You have experience working with relational databases at scale, including performance optimization and database tuning. You think beyond individual services and can reason about architecture, APIs, dependencies, data flows, and the impact technical decisions have across a broader platform. You have experience working in a product-driven environment and connect technical decisions to user and business outcomes. You make pragmatic engineering trade-offs and know when a simpler solution is more valuable than unnecessary technical complexity. You collaborate effectively within and across teams, sharing context and helping others make better technical decisions. You are comfortable contributing across the stack when needed, while your strongest expertise is in backend engineering. You adapt as requirements and systems evolve, approaching change with curiosity and sound technical judgment.

Where You'll Be::
This role is based in Toronto We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

  • Make thoughtful technical decisions and trade-offs, balancing long-term architecture with solutions that meet current product and business needs.

  • Partner with engineers and cross-functional collaborators across Spotify to understand authorization needs and build reusable platform capabilities.

  • Contribute to frontend experiences and data-related work when useful, while bringing deep expertise and leadership to backend engineering.

  • Raise engineering quality through strong technical judgment, design discussions, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing across the team.

• You have deep experience designing, building, and operating backend services, with strong knowledge of Java or comparable backend technologies.

  • You have experience owning distributed, high-scale, or business-critical systems where reliability, performance, and security matter.

  • You have experience working with relational databases at scale, including performance optimization and database tuning.

  • You think beyond individual services and can reason about architecture, APIs, dependencies, data flows, and the impact technical decisions have across a broader platform.

  • You have experience working in a product-driven environment and connect technical decisions to user and business outcomes.

  • You make pragmatic engineering trade-offs and know when a simpler solution is more valuable than unnecessary technical complexity.

  • You collaborate effectively within and across teams, sharing context and helping others make better technical decisions.

  • You are comfortable contributing across the stack when needed, while your strongest expertise is in backend engineering.

  • You adapt as requirements and systems evolve, approaching change with curiosity and sound technical judgment.

• This role is based in Toronto

  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Authorization team within Platform. What began by supporting Spotify for Artists has grown into foundational capabilities used across Spotify, including Music, Podcasts, and Audiobooks.

This is a backend-focused role working on systems that sit on a critical path for Spotify's creator ecosystem. You'll help us evolve these systems as they grow in scale and complexity, bringing strong backend engineering expertise while collaborating across product, frontend, and data when needed.

rows.description:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale.
You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.

What You'll Do:
Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users. Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time. Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales. Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes. Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience. Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users. Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.

Who You Are:
You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments. You think in systems and understand how APIs, integrations, platforms, and tooling can work together to create leverage across an organisation. You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations. You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress. You are curious about customer service and support operations and bring empathy for both the people providing support and the users receiving it. You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners. You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new. You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London, UK. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

rows.description:
We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the Business Analytics team within Spotify’s Business Strategy and Insights organization. Our team tackles some of Spotify’s most consequential strategic questions, shaping the trajectory of our business and improving the experiences of our over 700M active users across more than 180 countries.
 
In this role, you will use data analysis, experimentation, and statistical modeling to identify, assess, and launch a broad range of new initiatives and product features that span both product and business teams. You will also regularly assess the health of our business and identify areas of opportunity, translating these insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
 
At Spotify, you'll have access to some of the richest datasets in the world and the autonomy to explore them creatively and rigorously. Above all, your work will shape how the world listens, discovers, and connects through audio.

What You'll Do:
Develop data-driven strategies to support the growth of Spotify’s active users and subscribers  Create and communicate impactful findings and recommendations that improve the Premium product Model and forecast the impact of new business initiatives Work closely with business partners to understand the changes they are driving and help them discover new opportunities for growth Analyze experiments (A/B tests; quasi-experiments) to measure the impact of new features and go-to-market initiatives Present your findings to senior leaders, influencing the course of our business

Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of professional experience in data science or analytics, ideally at a consumer tech company or top-tier consulting firm. You are fluent in SQL and Python or R, and have a strong grasp of statistical methods and causal inference. Direct experience with product analytics or experimentation is a plus. You enjoy partnering with a range of cross-functional stakeholders and working on varied projects involving different products and problem spaces. You have a strategic mindset and an eye for cleanly extracting the “so what” from complex, technical analyses. You are an excellent communicator adept at presenting to senior leadership and audiences of varying levels of technical knowledge. You are comfortable working through ambiguous, complex problems and don’t get discouraged when the path forward isn’t immediately clear. You hold at least a Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role Anthropic is looking for a Communications Lead to own external communications for the Claude Platform, our API. The Claude Platform is how many of our customers put Claude to work, and this role shapes how that work is understood beyond Anthropic: from flagship product launches to the steady cadence of capability releases and developer-facing news. You'll sit on the Product Communications team and work day to day with the Platform product and engineering teams, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations. You should understand how developers and enterprises actually build with APIs and be comfortable engaging with developer tools and hold a clear point of view on what makes a product land. Key responsibilities Own communications for the Claude Platform end to end: capability releases, product updates, and the steady cadence of developer-facing news Build and maintain strong relationships with the journalists, newsletter writers, and creators covering AI platforms, enterprise software, and the API economy Prepare Platform leaders to be effective spokespeople for press, podcasts, panels, and the smaller moments in between Partner with Product and Engineering to align external narratives with how these products are sold and supported, and surface customer feedback back to the teams who can act on it Work across press, social, owned, and community channels, with the judgment to know which one carries a given moment and when to coordinate more than one at once Minimum qualifications Experience in communications, PR, or product marketing, including meaningful time on platform, API, developer, or enterprise products An understanding of both developer culture and enterprise buying, and the judgment to read timing and tone when the conversation around AI gets noisy Strong instincts for which product moments deserve the spotlight and which don't, and genuine curiosity about what makes a launch land A demonstrated ability to operate with high agency and low ego, with a bias to action Preferred qualifications 8-10 years of experience in communications, PR, or product marketing Communications experience at a developer platform, API-first, or enterprise software company Existing relationships with reporters and analysts covering AI platforms, enterprise tech, or the developer ecosystem Experience managing communications for AI or ML products Are very online: you follow the right channels, know what's moving through Hacker News and developer social chatter, and catch things early The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$265,000—$295,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. rows.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.
Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.
Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.
As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do:
Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use. Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints. Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers. Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail. Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap. Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs. Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents. Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.  

Who You Are:
You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design. You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery. You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production. You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems. You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences. You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems. You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling. You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

rows.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Growlithe is a fast-moving squad within Spotify's Conversation Product Area, focused on bringing emerging Search and agentic experiences to life. We explore, define, build, validate, and optimize new ideas to help listeners discover the content they love. Our work spans personalized Search, music video discovery and ranking, audiobook Search expansion, and the foundations of more social Search experiences. We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to help shape the next generation of Search at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, personalization, and product development, turning complex challenges into intuitive discovery experiences for millions of listeners.

What You'll Do:
Build and improve machine learning models that make Spotify Search more relevant, personalized, and engaging for listeners. Develop and optimize ranking and backend retrieval systems that help listeners discover music, videos, audiobooks, and other content. Explore emerging AI and agentic approaches to create more intuitive and conversational Search experiences. Design, implement, and evaluate machine learning solutions, taking ideas from early experimentation through production. Partner with engineers, product managers, designers, and researchers to identify opportunities and deliver meaningful improvements to Search. Use experimentation, data analysis, and performance metrics to understand model behavior, validate hypotheses, and improve the listener experience. Contribute to scalable machine learning infrastructure and engineering practices that support reliable, high-quality Search experiences. Share knowledge, challenge assumptions constructively, and help shape the technical direction of machine learning within the squad.

Who You Are:
You have experience building, deploying, and improving machine learning systems in production environments. You have a strong understanding of machine learning approaches for information retrieval, search ranking, recommendation systems, or personalization. You are proficient in Python and comfortable working with modern machine learning frameworks and data processing tools. You have experience and a desire to lean into backend engineering at Spotify scale. You understand how to design and evaluate experiments, interpret model performance, and translate technical findings into product improvements. You have experience working with large-scale datasets and understand the challenges of building reliable, scalable machine learning systems. You are curious about emerging AI technologies, including large language models and agentic systems, and interested in their potential to improve discovery experiences. You enjoy working across disciplines, communicating technical ideas clearly, and learning from different perspectives. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of complex challenges, and balancing experimentation with practical delivery.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Eastern Standard Time We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.

Within the Data Platform studio, we own two critical pillars: our event delivery platform that collects trillions of events per day from producers to consumers, and another, which handles the pseudonymisation of data so Spotify can use data responsibly and in compliance with privacy regulations. These systems sit at the heart of Spotify's data collection and are used by hundreds of teams across the company.
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of six experienced engineers distributed across Europe. You'll set the technical direction, ensure the team delivers high-impact work, and - just as importantly - invest deeply in the growth and careers of your engineers. If you're energised by both the technical challenges of large-scale data systems and the human side of building a high-performing team, we'd love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:
Lead and develop a team of six experienced engineers, with a strong focus on coaching, career development, and creating an environment where people do the best work of their careers. Take accountability for the team's delivery, ensuring clear priorities, healthy execution, and measurable outcomes. Partner with product and stakeholders to shape the roadmap for event delivery and privacy infrastructure. Drive technical strategy and architectural decisions for systems operating at Spotify scale. Build a culture of ownership, psychological safety, and continuous improvement. Collaborate across Data Platform and the wider engineering organisation to align on shared goals and dependencies. Manage on-call health, operational excellence, and reliability for the team's services. Actively participate in hiring, onboarding, and growing the team's capabilities.

Who You Are:
You have experience managing teams of senior/experienced engineers and understand that people leadership is your primary craft, not a side responsibility. You have a track record of investing in engineers' careers - running meaningful development conversations, helping people grow into new roles, and creating clarity around expectations and progression. You're comfortable with distributed data systems, event-driven architectures, or data infrastructure at scale - you don't need to write the code, but you can engage credibly in technical discussions and unblock your team. You hold yourself and your team accountable for outcomes, not just activity. You communicate clearly and build trust across functions and time zones. You've worked with distributed teams and understand how to create cohesion and inclusion when people aren't in the same room. You're excited about the potential of AI and LLMs to transform how engineering teams work - whether that's accelerating development workflows, rethinking how data infrastructure is built and operated, or helping your team adopt AI-assisted tooling effectively.

Where You’ll Be:
This role is based in London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
