rows.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.
You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

What You'll Do:
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand. • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close. • Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM. • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets. • Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion. • Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities. • Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development. • Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale. • Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products. • Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion. • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

Who You Are:
• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services. • You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies. • You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process. • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals. • You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams. • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems. • You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. • You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene. • You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Toronto. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The Canada base range for this position is $82,902 – $118,432 CAD plus equity. Benefits available for this position include extended health and dental coverage, retirement savings plans, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, and other benefits in accordance with Canadian employment standards. These ranges and benefits may be modified in the future.

We have a great opportunity for an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager to come and join the band in Berlin. The Artist & Label Partnerships team is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels & distributors.
As an Artist & Label Partnerships Manager your mission is to ensure that key artists, managers, and labels see Spotify as the #1 partner for artist development and monetization.
In this role you will work with a set of core label partners and artists. This role has a strong focus on launching innovative partnerships and initiatives and you will drive activations that enable, educate, and unlock new opportunities for our partners and Spotify. 
We seek a highly motivated partner manager based in Berlin with a strong partnerships, music marketing and music / entertainment / media background. This individual must be able to prioritize, multi-task, and influence in a fast paced environment. 
This role is on a 15-month fixed-term contract.

What You'll Do:
Build and foster relations with key partners (artists, managers, labels, industry organizations) across Germany, Austria and Switzerland Act as a representative of Spotify externally in the music industry and empower artists and labels with knowledge, insights, and tools they need to succeed on Spotify, acting as their advocate and champion. Music Marketing and culture: Stay ahead of music trends and key moments to proactively identify and activate new music and content opportunities. IRL events and music marketing: Proactively identify and pursue new growth opportunities in areas such as superfan engagement and live events together with cross-functional teams, work together to bring these initiatives to life. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Consumer Marketing, PR and other teams, acting as a representative of the artists & labels you work with.

Who You Are:
You have 2+ years of music industry experience, preferably in an artist & partner-facing role. You have experience and knowledge working in a broad spectrum of culture with a focus on music and content. You have a strong understanding of the digital music landscape and streaming platforms. You are an excellent project manager with a track record in leading projects from end to end, including marketing campaigns, live events and cultural activations You have experience in project managing offline to online activations, incl. Working on live events, content capture and digital extensions of those You possess excellent negotiating, presentation and people skills You are comfortable in very fast paced, driven work environments and can do well in a team that moves quickly You are well organized, with the ability to plan and deliver on tight deadlines You're a great teammate, adapt well to change, and have a positive attitude You are fluent in German and English

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Berlin, Germany We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come into the office 2-3 times per week. 

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. rows.description:
Spotify's Legal team is growing. We're facing innovative challenges that mirror the groundbreaking industry and product at the heart of our company. As we've expanded into more than 180 markets and our business has grown tremendously, we find ourselves facing new and interesting legal issues every day — including an increasing volume of patent disputes alongside the copyright and content matters that have always been central to our work.
As Legal Counsel, Litigation, you will work on a variety of litigation, copyright, patent, and other contentious and advisory matters, and help craft the way our company thinks about and handles them. The work we face is constantly developing, and the workload is growing faster than we can, so we will look to you to think thoughtfully about processes and policies that will help meet our goals. Your experience making risk-based assessments and proactively finding solutions to complex problems will be crucial. Significant e-discovery experience and experience conducting confidential inquiries are a plus.

What You'll Do:
Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation. Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes. Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives. Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently. Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment. Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation. Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others. Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement. Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas. Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures. Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.

Who You Are:
You hold a law degree (or equivalent) from a top-flight law school and are qualified to practice law as in-house counsel in the State of New York. You have 5+ years of litigation experience at a law firm, in-house, or both, including meaningful experience with copyright litigation. You have experience with e-discovery and managing complex, multi-jurisdictional disputes. You have experience contributing to teams that drive successful outcomes on complex matters. You have a demonstrated ability to evaluate copyright claims, work with technical experts, and develop defense strategies. You have a passion for solving legal problems and can explain legal concepts — including technical copyright issues — to non-lawyers. You are comfortable working with large data sets and technical subject matter; you may not be an engineer, but you can speak the language and understand the concepts. You are a problem solver who can stay calm when problems come your way. You have excellent judgment — you can think a problem through when you need to, but have also developed instincts that you can trust. You are self-motivated and can identify and complete work that needs to be done without being instructed. You can advocate for a position while balancing risk and multiple colleagues' and business considerations. You can balance many simultaneous tasks and triage to make sure the right matters get your attention. You're willing to roll up your sleeves and dig in on projects. You work well as part of a team — both with other lawyers and with non-legal business partners. You have very effective written and oral communication skills. Knowledge of music, media, tech, IP, and/or consumer issues is a plus. A technical background or experience with software, streaming, or audio technology patents is a plus but not required.

Who You’ll Be:
Onsite: (For example: You’ll be based in our New York office) We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $170,366 to 243,380, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Sell what you love. For us and millions of users across the globe, that’s Spotify. Join the Sales team and you’ll build the relationships that help grow our business in existing markets and beyond. We don’t just sell creative solutions to our clients and partners, we help to shape them; using our expert knowledge of ad products, sales channels and the industry to impact the way the world experiences music and podcasts. 


Spotify is seeking a talented and dynamic individual to join the team as a Contractor - Client Partner based in Sydney. This role will be responsible for driving revenue growth and building long-term relationships with key advertising clients and agencies.
You will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales, marketing, and product teams to deliver innovative advertising solutions that meet the needs of our clients while maximising revenue opportunities for Spotify.
Please note this is a fixed-term, 12 months, contractor role hired through a third party.

What You'll Do:
Own quarterly and annual revenue targets for your client portfolio, managing your sales pipeline and identifying opportunities for sustainable growth. Build and strengthen relationships with media agencies and advertising clients, understanding their business priorities and positioning Spotify as a valuable strategic partner. Collaborate with agency teams across media buying, strategy, planning, programmatic and branded content to develop effective advertising campaigns. Translate client challenges and business objectives into tailored advertising solutions that deliver measurable results. Develop compelling proposals and respond to client briefs, demonstrating how Spotify's audio, video, display and integrated advertising solutions can support their goals. Partner with internal Sales, Marketing and Product teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience, from initial conversations through to campaign delivery. Build an active network of client relationships through regular meetings, industry engagement and thoughtful account planning. Represent Spotify at industry events, sharing our advertising capabilities, insights and creative opportunities with clients and partners.

Who You Are:
You have 8+ years of experience in advertising sales, business development or client partnerships within digital media. You understand the digital advertising landscape, including programmatic advertising, audio, video and display, and can explain how these channels support different client objectives. You have experience building relationships with advertisers and media agencies in the Australian market, with a track record of growing accounts and delivering against revenue targets. You are familiar with programmatic advertising platforms, including demand-side platforms (DSPs) and supply-side platforms (SSPs). You know how to develop consultative sales strategies, lead commercial negotiations and present ideas that connect with different audiences. You are comfortable using Salesforce to manage client relationships and sales pipelines, as well as Google Slides and Sheets to create presentations and reports. You bring a collaborative, organised and adaptable approach, balancing commercial priorities while building trust with clients and colleagues. You communicate clearly, welcome different perspectives and enjoy finding creative solutions to business challenges.  Experience working with financial services advertisers would be valuable.

Working Arrangement:
This role is based in Sydney There will be some in person meetings, but there is flexibility to work from home.

rows.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
Enterprise AI builds and operates the internal AI platform layer that supports Spotifiers across the company. We’re helping evolve AI tooling into reliable infrastructure that teams can use in their day-to-day work. Our team builds the connective tissue between AI models and Spotify’s internal systems, with a focus on secure access, governance, identity, integrations, and dependable AI infrastructure.

What You'll Do:
Design, build, and operate secure enterprise AI platform capabilities that connect AI models, agents, tools, and Spotify’s internal systems. Own major workstreams across our enterprise AI infrastructure, including our Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and enterprise context capabilities, from technical design through launch and operation. Build reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations that enable AI-powered experiences across Spotify’s digital workplace. Help develop scalable approaches to AI governance, including identity-aware access, permissions, auditing, policy enforcement, and managing risks associated with third-party AI-enabled tools. Design, build, test, and evaluate agentic systems and workflows that help Spotifiers access information and accomplish tasks effectively. Take operational ownership of the services and components you build, balancing speed, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. Partner with engineers and stakeholders across Spotify to identify opportunities, make thoughtful technical tradeoffs, and turn emerging AI needs into scalable platform capabilities. Contribute to engineering practices, knowledge sharing, and AI fluency as we learn how to operate enterprise AI infrastructure at Spotify scale.

Who You Are:
You have strong software engineering fundamentals and experience building, testing, debugging, and operating reliable backend systems. You are experienced with backend languages such as Python, Go, or similar and are comfortable designing APIs and integrations across complex systems. You understand software architecture and how services, APIs, enterprise tools, and user-facing experiences fit together. You have experience with identity and authentication concepts and technologies such as OAuth, SAML, or SCIM. You have experience working with cloud infrastructure; familiarity with Google Cloud Platform is valuable. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, creating clarity, and independently making thoughtful technical tradeoffs. You care about operational ownership and building dependable infrastructure that other teams and employees can rely on. You enjoy experimentation, iteration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning in a collaborative engineering environment. Experience with enterprise SaaS or platform engineering, or with LLM integration patterns such as tool use, function calling, agentic workflows, or systems-level prompt engineering, will help you make an impact in this role.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in New York. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $164,448–$234,926 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

rows.description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

What You'll Do:
Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience. Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally. Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences. Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches. Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies. Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale. Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems. Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

Who You Are:
You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments. You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms. You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch. You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA. You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization. You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning. You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes. You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks. You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

Where You'll Be:
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

  • Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches.

  • Partner closely with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and designers to define and execute experimentation strategies.

  • Drive A/B testing, monitoring, model evaluation, and continuous optimization of recommendation quality, reliability, and cost efficiency.

  • Improve ML platform capabilities, data pipelines, and production systems that support personalization at Spotify scale.

  • Drive technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces and contribute to the long-term architecture of personalization systems.

  • Mentor and support other machine learning engineers, helping raise the bar across the team.

• You have 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production environments.

  • You have deep expertise in recommendation systems, ranking models, personalization, or large-scale content discovery platforms.

  • You have strong proficiency in Python and hands-on experience building machine learning systems with PyTorch.

  • You are experienced with large language model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and optimization techniques including SFT, distillation, and LoRA.

  • You have worked with large-scale inference systems and understand the challenges of latency, reliability, and cost optimization.

  • You care deeply about creating high-quality user experiences through thoughtful application of machine learning.

  • You communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, and you influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team

  • You know how to design, execute, and interpret online experiments and A/B tests to improve user outcomes.

  • You have experience operating distributed machine learning workloads using technologies such as Ray, FSDP, HSDP, or similar frameworks.

  • You are experienced building and maintaining data pipelines and orchestration workflows using technologies such as Flyte, Airflow, BigQuery, and cloud-based storage platforms.

• We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location.

  • This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

raw_data.descriptionBody:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.


Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world.


As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale.

Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system. Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified. rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate. We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Texas to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations. You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build. You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand. You will travel regularly within your region, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets. Key responsibilities Build and maintain trusted, sustained relationships with local elected officials, government agencies, economic development organizations, community groups, civic leaders, educational institutions, and workforce partners in the data center markets you cover Develop and execute a community engagement strategy for each of your markets, spanning site selection, pre-development, construction, and ongoing operations Build external coalitions, host education and listening sessions, and design local solutions that deliver real benefits to the communities where we operate Represent Anthropic in public forums, town halls, planning hearings, community events, and local media Monitor community sentiment and local political dynamics, and advise internal teams on risks, opportunities, and the right pace and posture for engagement Partner with the Real Estate and Infrastructure team to bring community input into how projects are planned, communicated, and delivered, not just how they are announced Work with the Communications team to develop proactive, locally relevant messaging Coordinate charitable giving, community investment, and economic development commitments in your markets, including managing nonprofit partner relationships Partner with the Energy and Sustainability team to explain our approach to environmental stewardship and respond to questions about power, water, and land use Build a community engagement playbook and repeatable processes that scale as Anthropic's infrastructure footprint grows Minimum qualifications Experience in community affairs, public affairs, economic development, government relations, local or regional government, or a closely related field Direct experience working for or engaging with local governments and a broad set of community stakeholders on behalf of large infrastructure, construction, energy, or technology projects, with a working understanding of how local politics and community dynamics actually play out A skilled relationship and coalition builder who earns trust with a diverse group of stakeholders, and who maintains relationships through difficult conversations The ability to represent a company credibly in public settings — town halls, hearings, press interviews Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn a complex operational plan into plain language that a local official or reporter can understand and respond to The ability to work independently, get up to speed quickly on complex policy issues, and manage multiple concurrent engagements across different markets without losing track of any of them Based in Texas or willing to relocate there, and prepared to travel regularly across the region Preferred qualifications 7+ years of experience in community engagement specifically on data center, utility, energy, or large-scale industrial infrastructure projects, or in local government Familiarity with land use, zoning, and permitting processes at the local and regional level Experience managing corporate social responsibility programs Established relationships with economic development, workforce, or civic organizations in the markets this role covers Experience working with real estate, legal, communications, and policy teams at the same time A genuine interest in the communities where you work, not just the projects you are managing The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$265,000—$295,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.description:
Content Platform is the foundation of Spotify’s experiences. We ensure our vast catalog of music, podcasts, audiobooks, video, and creator data is trusted, safe, and ready to power innovation across Spotify.
Our work spans content governance, platform safety, metadata, and machine learning systems that enable experiences such as Music Quiz, Playlist Mixes, Save to Spotify and SongDNA. Every day, our platform helps teams across Spotify build better products for millions of listeners and creators. 
As a Principal Product Managers you will own strategy directly. In this role, you’ll shape long-term direction, partner closely with engineering, machine learning, design, and business leaders, and deliver platform capabilities that have company-wide impact.

What You'll Do:
Define and evolve product strategy for your domain using customer insights, data, and long-term platform thinking. Lead complex product initiatives from early discovery through delivery in partnership with engineering, machine learning, data science, and design teams. Partner with machine learning engineers to shape model strategy, training data, evaluation frameworks, and human-in-the-loop systems. Collaborate with stakeholders across Spotify to align priorities, influence roadmaps, and drive platform investments that create lasting value. Make thoughtful product decisions by balancing customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform health. Champion platform safety, trust, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence as Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow. Help teams prioritize work that delivers the greatest long-term impact while maintaining focus on strategic outcomes. Communicate product vision, strategy, and progress clearly across technical and executive audiences.

Who You Are:
You thrive in highly autonomous environments and enjoy turning ambiguity into clear product direction. You have extensive experience leading product strategy and large cross-functional initiatives in complex environments, delivering measurable customer or business impact. You make thoughtful product decisions and clearly communicate the reasoning, trade-offs, and outcomes behind them. You think in systems and enjoy solving complex platform challenges that span multiple teams and technologies. You have experience building long-term product strategies where every investment strengthens future platform capabilities. You communicate effectively with technical teams, business partners, and senior leaders, building alignment across diverse stakeholders. You have experience working alongside machine learning teams and understand concepts such as model evaluation, precision and recall, and responsible AI development. You build trusted partnerships, collaborate with empathy, and create an environment where teams can do their best work.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Stockholm or London. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

rows.role: Director of Sales - Emerging & Scaled (New Business)
rows.description:
Spotify's Emerging & Scaled (E&S) business is growing rapidly across the US and Canada, and we're investing in accelerating first-time advertiser growth. As part of our mission to help brands connect with fans through audio and video, we're expanding our New Business organization. We're looking for an experienced Director of Sales to lead our New Business acquisition strategy across North America. In this role, you'll lead and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team, driving the full sales cycle from prospecting through closing. Reporting to E&S leadership, you'll shape scalable acquisition strategies, strengthen pipeline generation, and create a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching and measurable performance goals. You'll play a key role in unlocking new advertiser categories and driving sustainable net-new revenue growth.

What You'll Do:
Define and lead the New Business go-to-market strategy across the US and Canada, expanding Spotify's presence in new and underpenetrated advertiser categories. Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, outbound-focused sales team responsible for the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead qualification through negotiation and closing. Build scalable prospecting strategies, outreach frameworks, and repeatable sales processes that accelerate pipeline generation and first-time advertiser acquisition. Foster a results-driven sales culture through hands-on coaching, clear performance expectations, measurable KPIs, and disciplined pipeline management. Develop and implement sales playbooks, vertical-specific narratives, and performance storytelling that help sellers engage prospective advertisers and convert opportunities into revenue. Partner with Marketing, Sales Enablement, Product, and vendor teams to strengthen competitive positioning and develop effective acquisition strategies across Spotify's audio, video, and programmatic advertising solutions. Build relationships with agencies, brands, and senior decision-makers, identifying new opportunities and turning first-time advertisers into long-term partners. Own net-new revenue targets, pipeline health, forecasting accuracy, and sales performance, using Salesforce and data-driven insights to identify opportunities and continuously improve results.

Who You Are:
You have 10+ years of experience in digital media sales or related B2B industries, including 5+ years leading, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams. You have proven experience leading high-velocity, outbound-focused B2B sales teams, ideally within digital advertising, ad tech, SaaS, martech, or performance marketing. You have a strong track record of driving net-new customer acquisition, building scalable prospecting strategies, and leading teams through the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to closed-won business. You know how to build a results-driven sales culture through disciplined pipeline management, measurable KPIs, hands-on coaching, and continuous performance improvement. You have a deep understanding of digital advertising, including direct and programmatic buying, measurement, advertising technology, and data-driven solutions. You have experience setting and delivering ambitious new-business revenue targets, using pipeline metrics, conversion data, and sales forecasting to guide decisions and improve performance. You know how to build trusted relationships with senior agency and brand decision-makers, understand their business challenges, and communicate the value of advertising solutions. You are an inclusive, collaborative leader who enjoys developing talent, building strong teams, and partnering across functions to achieve shared goals.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in New York We ask that you come into the New York office 2-3 times per week. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $137,999 - $197,142, plus equity, plus bonus or commission. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

rows.role: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Messaging Platform
rows.description:
Spotify’s Subscriptions Mission focuses on converting listeners into lifelong subscribers by delivering seamless, valuable experiences across pricing, packaging, and customer journeys. We build the systems and tools that power acquisition, retention, and overall subscription growth at scale.
The Messaging Platform powers Spotify’s communications to over a billion users — from push notifications to emails and in-app messages that connect listeners to the content they love. Within this space, the Paloma squad focuses on message optimization: deciding which message reaches which user, through which channel, and at what moment.
We’re evolving how messaging works at Spotify — moving from short-term optimization toward systems that understand long-term user journeys. By combining reinforcement learning approaches with deeper domain signals, we’re expanding how machine learning shapes the entire messaging funnel.

What You'll Do:
Design, build, and ship machine learning models that optimize messaging across push, email, and in-app channels Plan and run A/B experiments in a multi-objective environment, balancing conversion, engagement, retention, and reachability Contribute to reinforcement learning systems that optimize for long-term user outcomes rather than immediate interactions Partner with product managers, data scientists, and engineers to define what success looks like and how to measure it Own the full ML lifecycle, from data and modeling to deployment, monitoring, and iteration Integrate ML models with upstream systems, including domain value signals and opportunity generation frameworks Help shape the future of AI-assisted development within the team, exploring how tools can accelerate experimentation and delivery

Who You Are:
You have strong experience building and deploying machine learning models in production environments at scale You are comfortable translating business problems into ML solutions and discussing trade-offs with cross-functional partners You have worked on complex optimization problems such as ranking systems or multi-objective decision-making You bring hands-on experience with PyTorch and distributed systems such as Ray or similar frameworks You understand experimentation deeply and can design reliable tests in environments with interacting metrics You are able to analyze results using approaches like causal inference or metric decomposition when needed You have experience with or curiosity about reinforcement learning and long-term optimization systems You enjoy working across disciplines and navigating ambiguity while shaping strategy and direction  

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London and Stockholm We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

rows.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Enterprise team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on organizations with 1,000+ employees, where engineering environments are complex, buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and large deals can take many months to close. Success in this role comes from long-term strategy: building account plans, developing deep relationships, and positioning our products as a strategic investment in how large engineering organizations work.
You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to close new business, expand existing customer relationships, and cross-sell products across our portfolio. Your ability to understand both the technical depth of our products and the strategic priorities of senior engineering and business leaders will be key to your success.

What You'll Do:
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support. • Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth. • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal. • Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time. • Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals. • Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success. • Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations. • Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale. • Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers. • Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning. • Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap. • Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

Who You Are:
• You have 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including experience selling enterprise software, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services. • You have a proven track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals and achieving or exceeding revenue targets. • You are experienced in strategic account planning, building multi-threaded relationships, and navigating long sales cycles with multiple stakeholders. • You have experience selling to technical and executive stakeholders, such as CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform teams, and DevOps leaders. • You are familiar with software development, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems, and understand how engineering organizations make buying decisions. • You are comfortable managing procurement processes, security reviews, and legal negotiations for multi-year agreements. • You can translate technical value into business outcomes and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, along with a strategic approach to long-term account development. • You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in New York City or San Francisco. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $110,392-157,704 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

rows.description:
The Music Mission enables Music creators to grow, engage & monetize their fan bases on Spotify. Central to the Music Mission's vision is the development of promotional tools for artist and label teams, powered by Spotify's deep knowledge of listener behavior. Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos and Clips enable artists and their teams to grow, monetize and connect with their audience. We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode, part of the Music Mission. Discovery Mode helps artists and music marketers reach new listeners when it matters most. Artists and labels flag priority songs, and our system feeds that signal into the algorithms behind personalized playlists.
In this role, you'll partner with product, engineering, and user research to build the technology that powers Discovery Mode. Your focus will be customer engagement and reporting — understanding what customers need, building instrumentation and dashboards for our self-serve product, and running experiments that improve the experience and drive business impact. As part of the Product Insights team, you'll help define the next generation of promotion products for the music industry.

What You’ll Do:
Work closely with cross-functional teams of data scientists, researchers, product owners, engineers, designers, marketers, and others across the company to develop the next generation of promotion tools for artists. Identify the most impactful opportunities for product development based on user needs, and execute on them diligently and resourcefully. Define metrics and build the dashboards we use to measure the health and success of our products. Partner closely with other data scientists to inform, build and test hypotheses that deliver actionable insights to improve and expand our products. Contribute to a community of data scientists by evolving best practices and learning new skills. Maintain a culture of rigor and data-informed decision-making to drive tangible business impact.

Who You Are:
Demonstrated ability in a similar Data Science role. Degree in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, mathematics, or a similar quantitative field. You have experience with product analytics, including crafting success metrics, performing exploratory analysis and presenting findings with clear product recommendations or implications. You have experience as a Data Scientist using experimentation to drive product development. You have hands-on experience synthesizing insights from data using tools such as Python, DBT, BigQuery, SQL, Tableau. Strong communication skills and value building strong relationships with colleagues and partners as well as the ability to explain sophisticated topics in straightforward terms. You’re a compelling storyteller who can communicate in succinct and inspiring ways to audiences with varied data science experience to influence product or feature decisions. Bonus if you have experience with advertising.

Where You’ll Be:
This role is based in our New York office.  This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.

The United States base range for this position is $ 94,584 - $ 135,121 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

Products like Discovery Mode, Marquee, Showcase, Music Videos and Clips enable artists and their teams to grow, monetize and connect with their audience. We're looking for a Data Scientist to join Discovery Mode, part of the Music Mission. Discovery Mode helps artists and music marketers reach new listeners when it matters most. Artists and labels flag priority songs, and our system feeds that signal into the algorithms behind personalized playlists.
In this role, you'll partner with product, engineering, and user research to build the technology that powers Discovery Mode. Your focus will be customer engagement and reporting — understanding what customers need, building instrumentation and dashboards for our self-serve product, and running experiments that improve the experience and drive business impact. As part of the Product Insights team, you'll help define the next generation of promotion products for the music industry.

This is an operations role with engineering depth behind it. You'll work across the same technology stack as our broadcast engineering practice with your center of gravity in execution and service. You'll keep our event spaces in a state of readiness through preventative maintenance, and be the calm, capable presence that executives, comms partners, and event producers learn to trust. Your work directly enables the collaboration and transparency that advance our AI safety mission. Responsibilities Live Event Production & Run-of-Show Own the technical execution of live and hybrid events, from small executive presentations to company-wide all-hands broadcasts reaching thousands of participants Serve as technical director for live productions across the full range, up to and including executive presentations and company-wide broadcasts Operate production systems during live events including video switchers, audio consoles, camera systems, playback, and streaming encoders Build and run the technical run-of-show: cue sheets, source lists, rehearsal schedules, and backup plans Direct contractors and onsite technicians during productions, delegating clearly under time pressure Troubleshoot and escalate complex production issues with clear diagnostic context Communicate status, risk, and resolution to non-technical stakeholders in clear, calm, jargon-free language Handle confidentiality and access requirements for sensitive sessions, including recording and streaming controls Event Intake, Scoping & Scheduling Own the event technology intake process end-to-end: request triage, technical scoping conversations, and staffing Right-size production approach to event template, runbook, or gear list that makes the next one easier than the first and repeatable by the team Maintain the event technology calendar and coordinate coverage across the AV Operations team Partner with Events, Internal Communications, and Workplace teams on lead times, expectations, and readiness Support Operations & Room Health Execute preventative maintenance programs and recurring room sweeps across event spaces and conference rooms Maintain and test inventory of equipment including wireless microphones, cameras, and portable production gear pre event, following event production framework Contribute to runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base documentation Surface recurring operational pain points to AV Engineering as candidates for systemic fixes You May Be a Good Fit If You: Have 8+ years of hands-on experience in AV operations, live event production, or technical event support Have owned the technical side of live productions end-to-end — not just operated a single position Bring working fluency across event audio, video, camera, and streaming systems, with enough depth to diagnose problems rather than only report them Are energized rather than drained by being the front-facing technical partner to executives and event producers Bring structure to ambiguity by building systems for repeatable events Strong Candidates May Also Have: Technical direction for corporate broadcasts, conferences, or multi-camera productions Q-SYS DSP platform, including reading and reasoning about existing audio/video routing and control designs PTZ and professional camera systems, camera control units, and multi-camera workflows Video conferencing platforms and hardware including Google Meet, Zoom Rooms, and hybrid meeting technologies Live streaming workflows including encoders and encoding settings, contribution and delivery protocols (RTMP, SRT, HLS) Network fundamentals for AV-over-IP including multicast, VLANs, QoS, and bandwidth management Ticketing and workflow systems such as Jira, and building intake or request workflows within them Coordinating AV contractors, integrators, and labor for event coverage Role Specific Location Policy: This role will be based in our San Francisco HQ This role is expected to be in office 5 days per week Occasional evening and early-morning coverage is expected around major events 4-6 weeks of travel annually will be expected for this role for distributed event support as needed Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.role: Senior Backend Data Engineer – Content Intelligence
rows.description:
The Experience team designs Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
The Content Intelligence Product Area is a core part of Spotify’s Content Platform within the Experience mission. We build systems that create deep, machine-readable understanding of content across audio, video, text, and images before it reaches users. This enables automation, safety, and entirely new product experiences. Our work powers content enrichment, quality analysis, annotation platforms, and scalable intelligence systems that allow teams across Spotify to build without needing direct content understanding expertise.
We’re looking for a Senior Backend Data Engineer to help build and scale the systems powering content understanding across Spotify. This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, distributed data systems, ML infrastructure, and applied AI. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of significant engineering problems while working alongside other Engineers.

What You Will Do:
Design, build, and evolve scalable backend and data systems powering Spotify’s content intelligence capabilities Take end-to-end ownership of significant engineering projects, from technical design and architecture through implementation and operation Build reliable infrastructure for large-scale content processing across audio, video, text, and images Create RFCs and contribute to architectural decisions within your squad and across connected systems Develop reliable and cost-efficient systems for high-throughput data and content-processing workloads Work with distributed data systems and large-scale content-management infrastructure Partner closely with other Engineers to plan and deliver technical solutions Contribute to AI and LLM-enabled workflows and infrastructure, including systems for content understanding, enrichment, and processing Evaluate and integrate AI capabilities into production systems at scale Build a strong understanding of adjacent systems and contribute to a shared on-call rotation Contribute to technical quality and engineering best practices across the team

Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, with strong experience in backend and/or data engineering You have deep expertise in either backend or data engineering and are comfortable working across both disciplines You have experience building and scaling large-scale distributed systems You have strong programming experience in Java, Scala, and/or Python You understand how to design systems with scalability, reliability, performance, and cost in mind You’re comfortable taking end-to-end ownership of complex engineering problems You can translate technical problems into designs, RFCs, and executable engineering plans You communicate effectively and enjoy collaborating with engineering, product, and technical stakeholders You’re comfortable operating in an environment where backend, data, ML infrastructure, and AI increasingly overlap You’re able to participate in a shared on-call rotation Experience with ML infrastructure, AI/LLM systems, agents, model evaluation, or integrating model APIs at scale is a plus Exposure to large-scale multimedia processing, audio processing, search, or recommendation systems is a plus

Where You’ll Be:
This role is based in London or Stockholm We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly. Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand. rows.description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to help shape Spotify's TV and Desktop experiences. These surfaces give people different ways to enjoy Spotify, from music and video in the living room to the experience that accompanies them throughout their day on a computer.
As a senior individual contributor, you'll work across both areas, bringing a strong product perspective to the opportunities that matter most. You'll help teams make ambitious choices, navigate complexity, and deliver experiences that people love.

What You'll Do:
Shape a compelling product vision and strategy for TV and Desktop, grounded in how people use each surface and the opportunities to improve their experience. Identify where to invest, what to experiment with, and how to measure success, combining user research, data, and thoughtful product judgment. Lead complex, cross-functional product initiatives from exploration through launch and iteration, aligning priorities and navigating dependencies along the way. Partner closely with engineering, design, and insights to create intuitive, high-quality experiences that balance usability, performance, and reliability. Connect product decisions across Spotify and with external partners where relevant, recognizing the different opportunities and constraints of each platform. Communicate a clear and compelling product narrative that brings teams and senior stakeholders together around shared priorities. Elevate product thinking across teams by encouraging curiosity, constructive debate, and a focus on meaningful outcomes.

Who You Are:
You have a strong track record of shaping product strategy and delivering high-quality digital consumer experiences across multiple teams. You know how to turn ambiguous opportunities into clear priorities, actionable decisions, and measurable value for users. You combine a deep understanding of user needs with product intuition, data, experimentation, and an openness to changing your perspective. You understand technical trade-offs and can collaborate effectively with engineering teams working on complex platforms. You build alignment and influence decisions across disciplines, teams, and organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority. You communicate complex ideas clearly and can bring diverse stakeholders together around a shared product direction. You're comfortable moving between long-term strategy and hands-on execution, adapting your approach to different product challenges. You value collaboration, thoughtful experimentation, and creating an environment where different perspectives help shape better products.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Stockholm or London We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
