rows.description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.An overview of this role As a Customer Success Architect, you'll serve as a trusted strategic advisor and technical authority to some of GitLab's most complex and high-value Enterprise and Government customers across Japan. In this role, you will be driving and shaping how our largest customers adopt GitLab's intelligent DevSecOps platform to achieve their business goals and realise meaningful, long-term outcomes. You will be working closely with customers after the sale to turn pre-sales command plans into clear success plans, guide them through their customer journey, and drive adoption, utilization, and technical maturity. You will also be directly influencing renewal and expansion decisions through your post-sales engagements with executive-level decision makers in the account. This is a individual-contributor role for someone who has already led pre or post sales customer engagements in large complex accounts across multiple industry domains to drive quantifiable business outcomes..The individual is comfortable operating with ambiguity, and can credibly advise VP- and C-level stakeholders on business transformation, application modernization, platform strategy, architecture, and organizational DevSecOps transformation. You'll also be shaping playbooks and best practices, and acting as an escalation point for the team's most technically or politically complex situations. Reporting into the APJ Customer Success organization, you'll own a portfolio of GitLab's most strategic enterprise and Government accounts, act as the executive-level technical liaison for these accounts, and drive cross-functional resolution of their highest-priority issues — coordinating and, where needed, directing the efforts of Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Support. You'll bring deep technical expertise in CI/CD, cloud platforms, multi-cloud, hybrid architecture and enterprise DevSecOps practices.You will use that expertise to shape customers' long-term platform strategy, apply best practices, configure GitLab for their environments and stay current with platform capabilities. In your first year, success will look like establishing yourself as the trusted senior advisor across a portfolio of flagship accounts, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, materially improving and increasing platform maturity, leading retention and renewal conversations, increasing customer satisfaction across your portfolio and contributing to the broader CSA team's technical standards and ways of working. Some examples of our projects: Turning pre-sales command plans into measurable customer success plans that align technical adoption with business outcomes Leading and driving the technical strategy behind a large-scale DevSecOps platform consolidation for a regulated Enterprise account or Government, including guiding enterprise customers on GitLab best practices across CI/CD, DevSecOps, cloud architecture, TCO, applying compliance and architecture as well as business case presentations to customer executives Owning end-to-end resolution of a critical, multi-team escalation for a flagship account — driving root cause analysis, coordinating Engineering/Product/Support, and personally briefing customer executives on remediation What you’ll do Owns a book of Enterprise and Government customers and drive adoption, retention, expansion, and overall satisfaction through ongoing strategic, business and technical engagement. Serves as the senior post-sales strategic, business and technical advisor for a portfolio of GitLab's most complex, highest-value enterprise and Government accounts, shaping multi-year platform and DevSecOps strategy in partnership with customer executives, coordinating responses to questions, issues, and escalations across Support, Product Management, Sales, and Professional Services. Translates ambiguous, high-stakes business outcomes into rigorous Customer Success Plans that are regularly reviewed with customer stakeholders. The Customer Success Plans contain clearly defined business outcome related goals, quantifiable benefits, realistic adoption milestones and remediation actions. Prepares executive-ready reporting conducted on a regular basis with clear accountability for outcomes that demonstrate impact on adoption, retention, and expansion of GitLab products and services. Provides deep technical guidance on enterprise-scale CI/CD architecture, DevSecOps maturity models, platform consolidation strategy, including advising on complex trade-offs (e.g., multi-cloud vs. hybrid, self-managed vs. GitLab Dedicated, etc). Owns the full lifecycle of your account portfolio's adoption, retention, and expansion outcomes, with direct accountability for the commercial and technical health of flagship relationships. Leads end-to-end resolution of critical, cross-functional account escalations, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, holding internal teams accountable to timelines, driving the root cause analysis and personally managing executive communication and risk. Leads end-to-end resolution of critical, cross-functional account escalations, ensuring root causes are identified, follow-up actions are owned, holding internal teams accountable to timelines, driving the driving root cause analysis and personally managing executive communication and risk. Designs and delivers technical enablement programs at scale, identifying systemic maturity gaps across a portfolio and building the roadmap (not just individual sessions) that closes them. Advises key customers stakeholders on cloud and platform architecture decisions with enterprise-wide impact, which includes multi-region deployment strategy, secrets management architecture and network/security topology for regulated environments. Guides customers on GitLab platform best practices including Git workflows, branching strategies, CI/CD pipeline design, DevSecOps adoption patterns, and security scanning configuration. Provides hands-on technical enablement and onboarding, including education on GitLab features, releases, and use cases, and identification of training and maturity opportunities aligned to customer goals. Engages customers on cloud platform architecture decisions relevant to their GitLab deployment — including self-managed vs. GitLab Dedicated, Runner configuration and auto-scaling, secrets management, and network topology considerations. Advises customers on DevSecOps consolidation value — articulating the TCO, compliance, and developer experience case for platform consolidation over fragmented toolchains. Collaborates with Professional Services, Sales, and internal teams to identify expansion opportunities, recommend enablement interventions, and ensure a seamless customer journey from onboarding through renewal. What you’ll bring Must be a Japanese citizen based in Japan Mandatory Japanese (native or professional level) and English language proficiency Hands-on experience building or owning CI/CD pipelines end to end, including pipeline as code, multi-stage design, artifact management, and troubleshooting in real-world environments. A career built across different direct customer facing engagement roles such as Technical Account Management, Technical Solution Sales, Pre-sales, Business Development, Consulting, Professional services across customers in different industry vertical domains like Government, Banking, Financial and Insurance Services, Manufacturing, Telecommunications, engagement with multiple technology and platform transition experience such as from on-premise deployments to Cloud, application modernization experience from monolith to microservices, from Waterfall to DevOps to DevSecOps and others to provide the depth and breadth of experience to advise customers on transformations and deployments that you've already seen play out elsewhere across your multiple customer engagements. A long-standing demonstrated track record as the person other senior people call when an account is in genuine crisis or gained across a sustained career of Enterprise or Government account ownership Credible judgment earned by personally owning the outcomes of dozens of complex enterprise customer account engagements over the course of a career, including situations with real commercial, technical, and reputational stakes A consistent track record of being trusted by customer executives and internal leadership to operate with minimal oversight in ambiguous and high-pressure situations Deep, hands-on expertise in DevSecOps practices, including shift-left security and integrating SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning into development workflows as well as architecting and troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines at enterprise scale Expert-level understanding of Git, merge request workflows and delivery lifecycles, having personally guided organizations through branching strategies such as trunk-based development and GitFlow, and modern software delivery lifecycles. Demonstrated experience with infrastructure as code, GitOps, Cloud and on-premises environments with relevant experience that support GitLab deployments, including networking, identity and access management (IAM), secrets management, and deployment considerations for regulated or high-security environments Demonstrated experience partnering with customers to turn business requirements into actionable success plans, with measurable goals and verifiable business outcomes that are suitable for executive-level quarterly reporting. Demonstrated ability to drive product adoption, dive deep into the accounts assigned and scale out the level of influence in the account. Demonstrated ability to build and defend executive-level business cases (TCO, compliance, risk) that influence budget and platform strategy decisions Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational experience to manage a portfolio of enterprise and Government customers, balance multiple priorities, guide escalations, and coordinate effectively across customer teams and internal cross functional teams to resolve issues appropriately and in a timely manner. About the team The Customer Success Architect team is part of GitLab's Customer Experience organization. It supports strategic enterprise and Government accounts across the APJ region through hands-on technical guidance, consultative partnership, and practical problem solving. We act as a reliable technical advisor and an important link between customers and the broader GitLab ecosystem. We bring platform, cloud, and DevSecOps depth to customer engagements and work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Support, and Professional Services to address questions, guide customers through technical choices, navigate escalations, and help them realize measurable value from GitLab. Composed of team members working remotely across time zones, we operate asynchronously to support a focused set of strategic accounts across the region. It's a team well suited for people who enjoy solving complex customer challenges, building long-term partnerships, and helping enterprise organizations grow their maturity with GitLab in practical, measurable ways.How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being Flexible Paid Time Off Team Member Resource Groups Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan Growth and Development Fund Parental Leave Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application. Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us. GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role As an Applied AI Engineer on the Startups team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the top AI-native startups building in the physical world, across robotics, semiconductors, aerospace, manufacturing, and civil infrastructure, as they grow from early product to scale. Some of these companies build the hardware itself and want Claude woven into how they design, test, and operate it, and others build the software that engineers everywhere use to design, simulate, test, and scale, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with startup software and hardware engineering teams to help them build their products on Claude and run their own engineering with it, advising on implementation and agent design as they build what is newly possible with AI in the physical world. You will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to build real things, working alongside some of the strongest teams in the field on problems that matter and helping mechanical, electrical, and process engineers get the kind of step change that software engineering has had from agentic coding with tools like Claude Code. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll help startups build at the edge of what is possible with Claude. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise and your engineering domain knowledge to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the technical resources that enable physical AI startups to succeed with Claude. Responsibilities Serve as a deep technical advisor to high-potential startups building in the physical world, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they design, test, and run their own hardware, working alongside them to push the boundaries of AI in engineering, manufacturing, operations, and more Work hands-on with startup software and hardware teams through pair programming and architecture reviews that accelerate their development, and understand their engineering workflows end to end, from design and simulation through test, production, and operations, so that your guidance fits how real hardware gets built Develop prototypes and technical documentation, including evaluation suites, benchmarks grounded in real engineering tasks, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable startups to build, operate, and scale with Claude Create reference implementations and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example integrating Claude with CAD, simulation, design tools, or industrial automation Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about applying AI to physical systems such as reading drawings, 3D geometry, board layout and routing, GD&T, latency and on-premise constraints, and physical safety, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team Create technical content for startup audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and startup-focused events Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building You may be a good fit if you have Deep engineering experience in a physical discipline such as mechanical, electrical, aerospace, robotics, semiconductor, manufacturing, or civil engineering, gained by designing, building, or operating real hardware, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how physical things get built 4+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, ML or research engineer, robotics or controls engineer, hardware or systems engineer, or technical founder, with either production experience building LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, or a track record of successfully applying AI to real engineering work in design, simulation, test, or production Experience with startups or high-growth companies and a love of working with founders and small teams that move quickly Strong technical communication skills, with the ability to translate complex AI concepts into architectural decisions and actionable implementation plans for both software and hardware engineering audiences and to run technical workshops, hackathons, or developer-focused events A collaborative approach to working across teams, the range of a generalist who can context-switch from robots to chips to rockets to factories and get up to speed on a new domain quickly, and a passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$280,000—$320,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.role: Head of Product Management - Artist Products
rows.description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify’s end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. The Music team shapes how artists and their music show up on Spotify. Our work spans Spotify for Artists, content upload, artist identity and visual expression, promotion and discovery, and insights that help artists and their teams understand and grow their audiences. As Head of Artist & Label Product, you’ll lead the product organization responsible for these experiences, bringing together our artist and label products into a clear, connected strategy. You’ll lead PM managers and senior PMs, set direction across multiple product areas, and turn that strategy into meaningful outcomes for artists, labels, listeners, and Spotify. You’ll report to the VP of Product, Design and Insights for the Music Vertical and be a key member of the extended Music leadership team.  

What You'll Do:
Set the strategy and direction for Spotify’s artist and label products, connecting artist tools, promotion, discovery, expression, and insights into a coherent product experience. Own business and product outcomes across the portfolio, translating long-term strategy into clear priorities and near-term goals. Lead, coach, and develop PM managers and senior PMs, creating an environment where people can do their best work and continue strengthening their product craft. Advance how the product organization uses AI to improve the way we build, learn, make decisions, and deliver value. Make thoughtful prioritization and resource decisions across product areas, navigating trade-offs and keeping teams focused on the outcomes that matter most. Partner closely with Design, Engineering, Product Insights, Content, and Business leaders to build high-quality products at Spotify’s scale. Represent the needs of artists and labels in key product and business decisions, helping teams balance creator, listener, and Spotify priorities. Navigate a complex music ecosystem, including relationships with labels and distributors, legal and licensing considerations, and dependencies across Spotify.

Who You Are:
You bring 12+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading product managers and product management leaders. You have led complex product portfolios and can turn broad opportunities into clear strategies, priorities, and measurable outcomes. You have experience building products for multi-sided platforms and understand how to create value for different groups with distinct needs. You understand the commercial side of product development and are comfortable working across revenue, engagement, and user-experience goals. You have experience creating new products and scaling established products to serve large audiences. You can move comfortably between long-term strategy and detailed product decisions, communicating effectively with senior leaders while staying close to teams and customers. You build trusted cross-functional relationships and have delivered complex products across teams, disciplines, and organizational boundaries. You communicate complex ideas clearly and create frameworks that help teams make informed decisions and move forward.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in New York We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $229,874–$328,392 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

rows.description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
 
The IT Studio exists to remove the friction of work, unblocking Spotifiers anywhere, anytime, with simplicity and safety. We are the team behind the technology that approximately 8,000 Spotifiers rely on every day, spanning endpoint and device management, identity and access, networking and connectivity, IT service management and support, audio visual and meeting room technology, productivity and collaboration platforms, work management tooling, and the AI tools changing how everyone at Spotify works. Across 9 teams, we touch almost every part of how Spotify functions as a company.
 
We’re looking for an experienced engineering leader to lead a group of Engineering Managers and approximately 50 engineers and technicians across the studio. You’ll set engineering strategy, strengthen the technical practices that help our teams operate at their best, and partner closely with product and studio leadership to balance engineering investment with business priorities.

What You'll Do:
Lead and develop Engineering Managers across multiple teams, supporting their growth while creating clarity around outcomes and engineering excellence. Set and communicate engineering strategy across the studio, ensuring teams have clear technical direction aligned with IT’s mandate and Spotify’s business needs. Strengthen technical judgment across the Engineering Manager group, challenging processes that no longer add value and creating more space for architecture, quality, and team capability. Identify patterns and opportunities across teams and drive improvements in engineering practice, operational health, reliability, and ways of working. Establish and evolve engineering best practices across the studio, helping teams share knowledge and consistently improve how we build and operate technology. Champion reliability, security, compliance, and privacy as fundamental parts of engineering decision-making. Shape how AI is used across the company, both through the tools our squads build and how our engineers work day to day. Partner with studio and alliance leadership, procurement, legal, engineering counterparts, and teams across Spotify to make thoughtful technical investments and solve meaningful business problems.

Who You Are:
You have 8+ years of engineering experience and experience leading Engineering Managers across multiple teams. You have led engineering organisations at scale and can demonstrate how the technical strategies you’ve shaped have influenced meaningful outcomes. You bring experience with enterprise technology such as identity and access, SaaS platforms, endpoint management, workplace technology, architecture, or related systems, and can engage credibly in technical decisions across these areas. You have improved engineering practices across multiple teams and know how to balance developer productivity, operational excellence, reliability, and sustainable technical investment. You have developed Engineering Managers into stronger leaders and can point to meaningful growth and progression within the teams you’ve led. You’re excited about how AI is changing the way people and engineering organisations work and have practical experience applying AI tooling or related technologies. You focus performance conversations on impact rather than activity and can assess contributions across teams producing different kinds of outcomes. You’re a strategic thinker who can set direction across a broad organisation while staying close enough to the work to contribute when needed. You communicate complex technical and strategic ideas clearly, build inclusion into how you lead, and can make thoughtful decisions when working through ambiguity.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

rows.description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.
You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.

What You'll Do:
• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand. • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close. • Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM. • Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets. • Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion. • Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities. • Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development. • Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale. • Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products. • Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion. • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

Who You Are:
• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services. • You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies. • You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process. • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals. • You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams. • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems. • You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills. • You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene. • You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in New York City We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

The United States base range for this position is $87,069-$124,385 plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, 13 paid flexible holidays, paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

The Subscriptions Mission is shaping the future of how millions of people discover, purchase, and experience Spotify Premium. We build the platforms and tools that power Spotify's global subscription business, enabling new offers, pricing strategies, and commerce experiences that help our business move quickly while delivering exceptional experiences for listeners.
Join the Monaco squad, where we create the internal products that enable Spotify teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers with confidence. From subscriptions and prepaid products to pricing updates and promotional campaigns, our tools support business-critical operations through intuitive experiences, trusted workflows, and reliable platform services.
As a Senior Web Engineer, you'll develop end-to-end solutions spanning modern web applications. Working closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and business partners, you'll help create the tools that enable Spotify's global subscription business to innovate safely, efficiently, and at scale.

What You'll Do:
Build end-to-end features across modern web applications that support Spotify's global subscription business. Create intuitive internal products that enable business teams to launch, configure, and manage Premium offers through secure, guided workflows. Develop GraphQL and gRPC APIs that connect frontend applications with distributed platform services. Design efficient database schemas, implement data migrations, and optimize application performance using PostgreSQL. Build secure, reliable, and auditable systems that support business-critical financial operations and SOX-compliant approval workflows. Collaborate with engineers across the Subscriptions Mission to evolve shared platform capabilities, improve developer experience, and increase platform reliability. Write maintainable, well-tested code while contributing to technical design, architecture discussions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Participate in an on-call rotation to help maintain the reliability and availability of services powering Spotify Premium.

Who You Are:
You have experience building and delivering production software across on the front end. You have built modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js. You have experience designing or consuming GraphQL APIs and enjoy building schema-driven applications. You have worked with gRPC services and Protocol Buffers, or you're excited to deepen your expertise in distributed systems. You have hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or another relational database, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization. You care about writing reliable, maintainable, and well-tested software that delivers long-term value. You enjoy partnering with engineers, designers, product managers, and business stakeholders to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful outcomes. You have a passion for simplifying complex workflows and creating intuitive experiences for internal users. Experience with tools such as jOOQ, Flyway, Apollo GraphQL, DataLoader, Styled Components, Storybook, TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS, Material UI, or similar technologies will help you ramp up quickly. Experience building commerce platforms, subscription products, pricing systems, distributed systems, or large-scale platform modernization initiatives is beneficial.

Where You'll Be:
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the EMEA region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Central European and GMT time zones for collaboration.

rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.About the role We are looking for a Senior Manager, 3P Revenue Accounting & Reporting to join our Accounting team. You will own revenue recognition, month-end close and reporting for Claude sold through our cloud service provider (CSP) channels: AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Azure Marketplace. These channels are among the fastest-growing revenue streams at the company. They run on consumption-based, partner-reported data that changes every month. You will be the accounting point of contact for the finance and partner teams at AWS, Google and Microsoft. Internally, you will partner with Finance, FAB, Engineering and business teams to turn partner billing feeds into accurate, auditable revenue. You will also lead the automation of a close that is still heavily manual. If you want to build the financial infrastructure behind a fast-growing AI company, come join us in our mission to build safe, beneficial AI. Key responsibilities Lead the revenue close for cloud service provider Marketplace within a listed company timeline. Prepare and review revenue, revenue-share, reserve journal entries, accruals and true-ups including memos for accounting assessments and judgments. Own balance sheet reconciliations, reserves, and the usage-to-invoice-to-cash bridge. Perform monthly and quarterly flux analysis and prepare flux decks for leadership. Own quarter-end deliverables, including footnote disclosures, flux commentary and presentations to leadership and Corporate Accounting. Serve as the primary contact for external auditors. Review the work of accountants and contractors, set the close calendar, and keep close packages complete and audit-ready. Own monthly and quarterly 3P revenue reporting for leadership and FP&A, by partner, model, product, region and customer. Review partner usage, invoice, disbursement and fraud reports each month, and resolve data issues before close. Serve as the accounting point of contact for the finance, engineering and product teams and drive reporting improvements that support an on-time close. Apply ASC 606 to 3P arrangements, including principal-vs-agent, variable consideration and reseller arrangements. Estimate and document reserves, including credit loss (ASC 326). Assess the accounting for new 3P products, programs and billing changes, partnering with Technical Accounting on complex judgments. Partner with the Engineering teams to automate manual close processes, including SQL-driven workbooks, automated reconciliations and system-generated journal entries. Own 3P SOX controls, including design, documentation, gap remediation and audit evidence. Partner with FP&A, Treasury, AR and business teams on forecasts, cash and partner disputes. Minimum qualifications Have strong ASC 606 knowledge, especially principal-vs-agent, variable consideration, consideration payable to a customer, and consumption-based revenue. Have owned a month-end close with tight deadlines and reviewed journal entries, reconciliations and flux analysis. Have built revenue reporting from large, imperfect third-party data sets and reconciled it to the general ledger. Have managed external partner relationships where you depended on their data, and pushed for fixes. Have strong SQL skills (BigQuery or similar) and experience automating close workbooks or reconciliations. Have designed or operated SOX controls and supported external audits. Communicate clearly with accounting, finance, business and engineering teams. Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where processes are still being built. Preferred qualifications Have 10+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3+ years managing revenue accounting or close teams. A Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA or equivalent (ACA, ACCA). Big 4 audit experience combined with industry experience at a high-growth tech or SaaS company. Experience with cloud marketplace, reseller or channel revenue (AWS Marketplace, Google Cloud Marketplace, Azure Marketplace). Experience with usage-based and subscription revenue models. Hands-on experience with Workday Financials, NetSuite, Numeric, Hex or similar close and reporting tools. Experience with IPO readiness. Experience using AI tools to automate accounting and reporting work. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.Annual Salary:$190,000—$230,000 USDLogistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

rows.description:
We are looking for a strategic public policy professional to join Spotify’s Global Government Affairs team in New York City. The Government Affairs team helps Spotify understand the global and local policy landscape, advocates on issues important to our business and users, and works to anticipate and mitigate policy and regulatory risks.
In this role, you’ll work closely with Government Affairs colleagues and teams across Spotify to develop positions on public policy proposals and strategies to advance them. You’ll report to the Director of Government Affairs, US & Canada, with a particular focus on state and local policy.

What You'll Do:
Design and execute policymaker engagement strategies that strengthen Spotify’s relationships across priority jurisdictions, with a focus on New York City, New York State, and other key states. Develop expertise on public policy issues with commercial and reputational importance to Spotify, including tax, artificial intelligence, content moderation, and emerging policy matters. Identify and assess priority state and local public policy issues affecting Spotify, and partner with your manager and US Government Affairs colleagues to develop effective advocacy strategies. Collaborate with teams across Spotify, including Legal, Communications, Social Impact, Product, Compliance, and Trust & Safety, to understand business priorities, develop clear policy narratives, and shape approaches to key policy issues. Build relationships and partnerships with external organizations, including trade associations and civil society organizations, to advance engagement and thought leadership on priority public policy issues. Represent Spotify with policymakers, government officials, industry peers, and other external stakeholders in support of the company’s policy priorities.

Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of experience developing and implementing public policy or government affairs strategies and working with policymakers or other public policy stakeholders. You have experience working in government, the private sector, a trade association, or a related public policy environment. You have built strong relationships with policymakers and understand how to develop trusted relationships with officials in New York City, New York State, and other priority jurisdictions. You have experience developing public policy strategies related to the technology sector and can translate complex policy developments into clear business implications. You have experience engaging senior government officials, private-sector leaders, and public policy professionals. You can develop and execute effective advocacy strategies while balancing multiple stakeholders and priorities. You communicate clearly in writing and conversation and can adapt your approach for policymakers, business leaders, and cross-functional partners. You build collaborative relationships across functions and levels, approach problems with sound judgment and integrity, and are comfortable operating in a changing policy environment. You are able to travel throughout the United States as needed, including occasionally on short notice.

Where You'll Be:
This is a hybrid role based in our New York City offices (average 2 to 3 days a week required) Working hours? We operate within the EST zone for collaboration.

The United States base range for this position is $139,683–199,548, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.

rows.description:
Spotify is looking for a Marketing Manager to lead our marketing strategy and execution in Taiwan. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who can set strategy, lead integrated campaigns, create scroll-stopping social content, and make Spotify one of the most talked-about brands in one of Asia's most vibrant music markets.
Taiwan is the birthplace of Mandopop and a cultural tastemaker for the broader Chinese-speaking world. Growing the Spotify brand and business in this market demands genuine cultural fluency, a deep understanding of what resonates across social platforms, strong relationships within the music and creative industries, and the ability to turn insights into bold, locally relevant campaigns that grow our listener base and strengthen our connection with fans and artists.
Reporting to the SEA Head of Marketing, you'll work closely with cross-functional teams across Taiwan and the wider region to shape strategy, deliver impactful campaigns, and represent the Taiwan market at a regional and global level.
You'll partner with teams across Music, Growth, Communications, Business Development, Partnerships, and other functions to bring Spotify's brand to life in Taiwan and help unlock new opportunities for growth.

What You'll Do:
Own Spotify Taiwan's consumer marketing strategy, driving free user acquisition, engagement, and Premium consideration Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, out-of-home, experiential, and earned media with ideas designed to spark conversation and deliver measurable business impact Lead go-to-market planning for key product launches, seasonal campaigns, and major cultural moments Localize global campaigns for Taiwanese audiences, ensuring every activation reflects genuine cultural relevance rather than simple translation Use audience insights, market intelligence, and campaign performance data to inform decisions and continuously optimize marketing effectiveness Measure, analyze, and communicate campaign performance to regional leadership through clear recommendations and actionable insights Lead Spotify's Taiwan brand strategy in alignment with regional and global positioning while ensuring the brand feels authentic and locally meaningful Partner closely with the Taiwan Music team to develop campaigns supporting priority local and global releases and create scalable marketing frameworks for label partners Manage the Taiwan marketing budget, prioritizing investments that deliver the greatest impact Build and maintain strong relationships with creative, media, production, and agency partners to consistently deliver high-quality work Act as the voice of the Taiwan market, influencing regional and global stakeholders on campaign strategy, creative development, and market priorities

Who You Are:
You have 6+ years of experience in consumer or brand marketing, with strong experience leading marketing initiatives in Taiwan You have deep knowledge of Taiwan's music, entertainment, and cultural landscape, including Mandopop, emerging artists, internet culture, and local media You have successfully led integrated marketing campaigns from strategy through execution that delivered measurable business results You have created or led campaigns and social content that generated outsized reach, engagement, or cultural conversation relative to budget You know how to use data and customer insights to develop business cases, evaluate campaign performance, and optimize future marketing investments You have experience managing agencies, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced environment You have exceptional storytelling instincts and understand how to create culturally relevant campaigns that resonate with Taiwanese audiences You communicate confidently with senior stakeholders and can influence decisions across regional and global teams You are highly organized, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment You have experience working within technology, media, entertainment, or other consumer-focused industries You are fluent in both Mandarin and English, written and spoken

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in Taipei We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home

rows.description:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Subscriptions Mission. This team oversees the entire user journey on Spotify and ensures we engage with people in innovative ways, every step of the way. Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
 
As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
 
We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.

What You'll Do:
Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys. Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform. Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders. Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.

Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus. You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale. You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc. You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements. You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives. You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production. You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission. Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines.

Where You'll Be:
This role is based in London or Stockholm. We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Our team grows Spotify’s audience by finding future listeners around the world and delivering the right value to them, at the right time. With research, product development, product design, engineering, and marketing all collaborating in one organization, we’re able to quickly create meaningful features and services for millions of people around the world, resulting in joyful, long-lasting relationships with Spotify.
 
As a Senior Backend Engineer you will participate in building and maintaining the systems responsible for driving user conversion, retention and upsells together with other R&D teams, Marketing and Growth. The team is uniquely positioned to play a key role in a new effort to strengthen our platform capabilities in this area to support the rapidly growing business needs of the ever-changing product portfolio.
 
We are moving towards a more user focused, contextual conversion, retention and upsell experience that is less manually operated, and more consistent across channels, using levers like machine learning and personalisation. We want to solve this through a platformised approach utilising new systems for decision-making on what we want users to see combined with a content management solution that can handle all the necessary complexities.

lists.content:
• Architect, develop and operate Java services that serve our users through the merchandising platform to enable cohesive and relevant conversion and upsell journeys.
  • Collaborate with our squad and key internal partners to determine how to design scalable backend systems, data models and APIs that run on Google Cloud Platform.
  • Be a technical leader, mentor and valued contributor in an autonomous, cross-functional agile squad, in close collaboration with other squads and business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with other squads, engineering managers and product managers to identify and solve challenging problems, to successfully scale our automation and new platform capabilities.

• You have 5+ years of working experience as a Backend Engineer working with Java. Additional tools and technologies such as gRPC, GCP, BigQuery and Bigtable are a plus.
  • You have strong computer science fundamentals and previous experience building complex backend services at scale.
  • You have experience in designing, implementing, and scaling cloud-native software components on providers such as GCP, AWS, etc.
  • You have experience working directly with stakeholders to understand, document and develop APIs and systems to meet their requirements.
  • You are comfortable working collaboratively on cross-functional teams and independently driving complex delivery initiatives.
  • You have written distributed, high-volume services and know how to deploy and operate them in production.
  • You have a growth mindset and are passionate about your work, striving towards the team’s goals and, ultimately, the Spotify Mission.
  • Nice-to-haves: Experience modelling, building and operating integrations with external CMS solutions or working with ML teams for recommendations and data pipelines.

• This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

rows.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.Applied AI Research Engineer Applied AI Research Team, Applied AI About the role: As an Applied AI Research Engineer, you will discover what Anthropic's models and products can do, prove it with real customers, and equip the rest of Applied AI to sell and deliver it. You'll embed with product teams to build deep expertise on new capabilities as they develop, and serve as a critical feedback loop carrying field reality back to Product and Research so that what we build next reflects what customers actually need. In collaboration with Sales, Product, and Research teams, you'll sit at the intersection of what we build and how customers adopt it. You'll own the technical<> GTM handshake for model and product launches: testing new models to understand their strengths and limitations, building demos and evals, and helping field teams get ready. When strategic customers hit novel challenges, you'll go hands-on to solve them. And throughout, you'll synthesize what you're learning across customers and products into insights that shape our roadmap, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Research teams to stay calibrated on what's working, what's not, and what matters most. This role is equal parts researcher, field expert, and connective tissue between our customers and the teams that build our products. You'll need the technical depth to push the boundaries of what our models can do, strong communication skills to make complex capabilities clear to diverse audiences, and the instinct to turn what you learn in the field into signal that makes our products better. Responsibilities: Embed with product teams to build deep technical expertise on new products and capabilities as they develop, becoming the field's go-to expert in your domain Own the technical<> GTM handshake for model and product launches-- early testing, field readiness assessments, and ongoing capability education throughout the model lifecycle Build demos, evals, and prototypes that showcase customer-relevant model and product capabilities, and define what good performance looks like in important domains Develop enablement materials like playbooks, training sessions, and reference architectures in partnership with Technical Enablement, so Applied AI teams can effectively position and deliver new capabilities from day one Engage hands-on with strategic customers facing novel technical challenges in your domain, discover solutions, then package learnings into scalable approaches for the broader field Synthesize insights from across customer engagements and work with Product and Research to land them. Identify adoption patterns, common blockers, and capability gaps that should inform our research and product roadmaps Partner with Sales and Applied AI teams to support high-value accounts that need specialized domain knowledge Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and research collaboration You may be a good fit if you have: 6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, AI startup founder, or similar technical role -- ideally with some exposure to customers or end users A track record of going deep on technical problems and then translating what you learned into materials, training, or tools that helped others succeed Strong technical aptitude with strong proficiency in at least one programming language Meaningful experience building with large language models -- whether shipping LLM-powered products, developing agents or workflows, or integrating models into production systems Experience designing evals, building prototypes, or developing technical enablement for complex products The ability to quickly build domain expertise in new product areas and become a credible technical voice on new topics Curiosity about what AI models can actually do -- you enjoy probing the edges of new capabilities and figuring out what use cases just unlocked Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders, including exec-level The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the business problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions A collaborative, service-oriented mindset – go-to-market at Anthropic is a team sport Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. rows.description:
We’re looking for a Partner Manager to join Spotify’s Content Partnerships team and build meaningful relationships with creators across Lifestyle & Wellness. You’ll be a trusted partner to creators, helping them understand their performance, develop their audiences, adopt Spotify products, and find new opportunities to grow.
You’ll bring a strong understanding of video, podcasts, and the broader creator ecosystem. You’ll combine creator relationships, data, and sound judgment to help shape how Spotify supports creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, with a particular focus on Fitness.

What You'll Do:
Manage relationships with a portfolio of Spotify creators across Lifestyle & Wellness, helping them grow their presence and audiences on Spotify. Support the growth of Fitness on Spotify by identifying, recruiting, and onboarding high-value and high-potential creators and video content. Develop a deep understanding of creators’ businesses and goals, connecting them with Spotify products, programs, and opportunities that can deliver meaningful value. Use performance data and audience insights to advise creators on content strategy, audience development, and opportunities for growth. Help shape Spotify’s creator strategy and partner approach for Fitness by bringing forward creator insights, opportunities, and ideas as the space evolves. Develop and test new ways to support and engage creators, identifying successful approaches that can scale across the broader creator ecosystem. Collaborate with teams across Spotify to support priority creators, increase adoption of relevant products and features, and advance partner and company initiatives. Bring creator feedback, portfolio trends, and quantitative and qualitative insights back into Spotify to help inform content and product strategy.

Who You Are:
You have 5+ years of partner-facing experience in creator or talent relations, account management, business development, or a related field within an audio, video, social, talent management, or creator-focused organization. You have established relationships with podcasters and/or video creators and understand how to build trusted, long-term creator partnerships. You understand the audio, video, social, and creator landscape, including emerging formats and trends across Lifestyle, Wellness, and Fitness. You identify opportunities, develop ideas, and move work forward in areas where the path may not yet be fully defined. You use quantitative and qualitative insights to develop a point of view, make recommendations, and inform partner strategy. You communicate clearly and build credibility with creators, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders. You’re excited by the evolution of podcasts, video, and creator-led content and curious about how audiences discover and engage with it. You know how to balance high-quality partner support with prioritization and scalable ways of working.

Where You'll Be:
This role can be based in Los Angeles, CA or New York, NY We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in-person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home. We ask that you come in 2-3 times per week.

The United States base range for this position is $92,126–$131,609 USD, plus equity. The benefits available for this position include health insurance, six-month paid parental leave, 401(k) retirement plan, monthly meal allowance, 23 paid days off, paid flexible holidays, and paid sick leave. These ranges may be modified in the future.


Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

Design and operate Git and Gitaly service models that work across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS, with a clear view of which elements are common and which must differ between them. Maintain cloud-agnostic architecture and tooling decisions, avoiding designs that assume a single hyperscaler's primitives. Partner with the teams that own each deployment model so operational practices stay coherent rather than fragmenting into separate playbooks. Apply distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, and failure domains, to Gitaly's storage and replication model. Own elastic storage and compute strategy for Git repository data, including capacity planning, autoscaling, and consumption-based provisioning for GitLab's largest self-managed and SaaS customers. Hands-on subject matter expertise in Git internals, including how the protocol, object model, and storage layer behave under load and at scale, not only familiarity with Git usage. Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, replication, failure handling, and horizontal scalability. Experience running production infrastructure across multiple deployment models, such as self-managed, dedicated or single-tenant, and multi-tenant SaaS, or a credible path from adjacent experience to it. Experience with elastic storage and compute, and consumption-based system design for variable, unpredictable load. People management experience, ideally leading site reliability engineering-style or platform operations teams. Direct experience with Gitaly, libgit2, JGit, or another Git implementation's internals is advantageous. Experience operating cloud-agnostic infrastructure across multiple hyperscalers or on-premises environments is advantageous.
